In [[10,967 BBY]], during the [[Seventh Alsakan Conflict]], [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakani]] forces '''attacked''' the [[Pius Dea]] fortress world of [[Carida/Legends|Ord Carida]] with aid from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and a number of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]], including the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], [[Herglic/Legends|Herglics]], and [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="Warfare" />
